messages.author: John McDonnell
messages.body:
Hi All,
We are trying to install Amber22 on Ubuntu 22.04 with the Lambda Stack, which provides CUDA 12.2. The config fails, complaining that CUDA 12.2 is too new and that only as far as 12.1 is supported. Are there plans to support CUDA 12.2 or does anyone have a suggestion/workaround?
Thanks,
John.
--
John McDonnell
IT Architect
High Performance Computing Core Group
University of California Davis

messages.author: David A Case
messages.body:
On Fri, Sep 08, 2023, John McDonnell via AMBER wrote:
>
>We are trying to install Amber22 on Ubuntu 22.04 with the Lambda Stack,
>which provides CUDA 12.2. The config fails, complaining that CUDA 12.2
>is too new and that only as far as 12.1 is supported. Are there plans to
>support CUDA 12.2 or does anyone have a suggestion/workaround?
Edit the cmake/CudaConfig.cmake file.  On (about) line 76, change
"VERSION_LESS 12.2" to "VERSION_LESS_EQUAL 12.2".
....hope this helps...dac
